title: P13 driver counts each visit's sukses line twice, doubling the printed rate; headline rates and a bound were reported wrong
what_went_wrong: p13_wide_sample.sh counts grep -hc 'sukses=true' over the harness logs; two lines per visit match, so TOTAL_VISITS and the rate line are doubled (19.25/22.96/33.91 instead of 9.63/11.48/16.96).

The report's results table and R5 s25 kept the doubled rates; the Clopper-Pearson bound was written as 0.0215%/0.022% although its own formula gives 0.0899% (4x too small); the stage comparator stdout lines were quoted but not saved.
root_cause: The counter matches two log line formats; no cross-check of the printed rate against elapsed time and N; summary lines not captured to a file.
detection: Orchestrator review 2026-10-25 (recomputed from elapsed times; formula evaluated; evidence searched for the quoted lines).
impact: Cosmetic for the stop rule (a percentage, unaffected) and for results (comparator exit codes); wrong figures in prose only.

correction.applied: Prose corrected by strike-through in the P13 report, R5 s25, the 20261025 handoff and the QMS record. The driver is frozen and still doubles; not changed.
correction.result: Open: decide whether to unfreeze, fix, re-freeze and re-pin; a stage-0 re-run with saved comparator stdout would close the evidence gap.

rule: Print rates only with a cross-check (N / elapsed); save every summary line that the report will quote.
